# Manifest

## Root

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `Universal_NPC_Voice_Lab.html` | Single-file voice program with inline CSS/JS, NPC model registry, emotion regulator, sliders, export, browser TTS fallback, edited MP3 export payload, explicit voice-asset safety gate, and locked backend hook. |

## Docs

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `docs/README.md` | Usage and implementation notes. |
| `docs/MANIFEST.md` | This package inventory. |
| `docs/VOICE_MODEL_SELECTION.md` | The selected single biome voice-model per NPC. |
| `docs/REPOSITORY_VOICE_ASSIGNMENTS.md` | The selected repository voice folder/stamp per NPC. |
| `docs/RUNTIME_REPOSITORY_BRIDGE.md` | Backend/browser bridge for repository voice synthesis. |
| `docs/MP3_EXPORT_AND_SAFETY.md` | Edited MP3 export behavior, filename pattern, backend response shapes, and safety gating. |
| `docs/UNUSED_CODE_AUDIT.md` | Uploaded-source audit and exclusion notes. |
| `docs/LICENSES_AUDIT.md` | License status of inspected uploads. |

## Single-file runtime with embedded voice stamps

The program does not require npm, Python, model downloads, or external static assets at runtime. It embeds one short user-provided Coqui voice-pack stamp per NPC inside the HTML, uses browser-native Web Speech APIs for typed speech, and sends repository voice IDs to the optional backend call.


## Latest merged additions

- `docs/LEGACY_VERSION_AUDIT.md` — explains which prior versions were merged and what was integrated.
- `docs/legacy_versions/` — archived standalone HTML and docs from earlier NPC Voice Lab builds.
- `js/npc-lab-data.js` — now includes the restored `REPOSITORY_VOICE_CLIPS` data URI block for all 14 NPCs.
- `index.html` — now includes NPC search, repo voice stamp playback, stop audio, full slider editing, and backend MP3 export controls.
